title: United Kingdom: Sluggish labour data shapes BoE view – Deutsche Bank
summary: Deutsche Bank’s Chief UK Economist Sanjay Raja assesses latest United Kingdom (UK) labour market data as signalling a still weak backdrop, with employment struggling and vacancies falling.

title: Drone Strikes Cripple Half of Russia's Top Diesel Refineries
summary: Three of Russia's six largest diesel-producing refineries are now either shut or operating at roughly one-quarter capacity after Ukrainian drone attacks damaged plants that together form the backbone of the country's fuel system. The six refineries—Omsk, Kirishi, Taneco, Volgograd, NORSI and Perm—account for roughly half of Russia's diesel production, according to Reuters calculations based on market data. title: Australia's Energy Minister Heads to Saudi Arabia for Pipeline Answers
summary: Australian Energy Minister Chris Bowen will travel to Saudi Arabia next week to meet with Saudi Energy Minister, Prince Abdulaziz bin Salman, and get the latest updates on the state of operations and oil supply after the Kingdom shut down the East-West pipeline following drone attacks late last week.
